answer.verdict: Empty-queue GIF submit calls the GS on the caller buffer. 32-bit UNPACK with the mask off, MODE 0/3, and CL>=WL writes the same VU bytes as the per-lane loop. MFIFO span copies and the timer scaffold are not in this branch. 448/448.

facts.c: GifArbiter::submit drains in place only when drainImmediately is true and m_queue is empty; otherwise it still copies. submitGifPacket forwards its existing flag. flushMaskedPath3Packets still uses the 4-arg submit.

UNPACK fast path is VL=32, mask bit off, MODE 0 or 3, CL>=WL. V4 with CL==WL is memcpy with one wrap at vector 1024. S-32 broadcasts. V3-32/V2-32 copy 12/8 bytes. Everything else stays on the per-lane loop.
